It fires on each piece of that word whose same token appeared earlier in the context followed by another piece, so the first and middle pieces are strong and the last piece is weak. Text with no earlier copy is near zero, as are first occurrences, single-token common words repeated (Paris, John: about 0.1) and earlier copies tokenised differently (sentence-initial 'Mississippi' vs ' Mississippi'); repeated common short phrases ('the big red car' twice) or repeated random token strings reach only about 0.25-0.4.
